program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((top-markers (for/list ([c (in-range (cols g))] #:when (= (at g 0 c) 2)) c))
        (left-markers (for/list ([r (in-range (rows g))] #:when (= (at g r 0) 2)) r)))
    (if (not (empty? top-markers))
        (let ((axis (first top-markers)))
          (for/fold ([out g]) ([p (in-list (find-color g 5))])
            (let ((mc (- (* 2 axis) (second p))))
              (if (and (in-bounds? (first p) mc (rows g) (cols g))
                       (= (at out (first p) mc) 0))
                  (set-cell out (first p) mc 7)
                  out))))
        (let ((axis (first left-markers)))
          (for/fold ([out g]) ([p (in-list (find-color g 5))])
            (let ((mr (- (* 2 axis) (first p))))
              (if (and (in-bounds? mr (second p) (rows g) (cols g))
                       (= (at out mr (second p)) 0))
                  (set-cell out mr (second p) 7)
                  out)))))))
